conventions.convention: Scores are nonnegative losses to minimize, may equal infinity, and zero-probability labels contribute zero even when their score is infinite. The label count is K ≥ 2.

Full reliability conditions on the whole forecast vector; classwise calibration conditions separately on each coordinate; top-confidence calibration conditions on maximum confidence and breaks predicted-label ties by smallest index.
Finite-label conditional probability functions are supplied under AC, with the full power-set label sigma-algebra; no standard-Borel assumption on the instance space is required.
Equality of expected strictly proper scoring risks implies equality of forecasts only under finite posterior-forecast expected risk.

The surrogate Phi is finite, convex, nondecreasing and nonnegative on the real line, with monotone endpoint extensions. Conditional minimizers may be extended-real-valued. R01 counts every zero score as an error.

Fixed-bin underestimation requires joint convexity of the discrepancy. Refinement consistency uses Lipschitz r and vanishing mesh, with sample-size limits taken before refinement; no diagonal rate is asserted.
A margin premise with multiplier c yields coefficient 2c^(1/s). Counting zeros as errors requires the stated additive tie correction; predicting +1 at zero admits the separate correction-free bound.

load_bearing.statement: Full reliability, classwise calibration, and top-confidence calibration are defined by their respective event-integral identities. For a supplied measurable calibration function r and measurable nonnegative discrepancy d, expected calibration error is E[d(r(G),G)].

Assume AC. For a supervised prediction problem with arbitrary measurable instance space and K ≥ 2 distinct finite labels carrying the full power-set sigma-algebra, there is a measurable eta from the instance space to the probability simplex such that P(X ∈ A, Y = y_j) = E[eta_j(X)1_{X ∈ A}] for every measurable A and label index j.

A finite-label score loss has Borel-measurable nonnegative extended-valued sections. It is proper if its truthful expected loss is no larger than any reported expected loss, and strictly proper if equality implies the report equals the true distribution.

For every K ≥ 2 and p,q in the probability simplex, logarithmic and Brier expected losses satisfy Sbar(p,p) ≤ Sbar(p,q), with equality only when q = p. Truthful expected logarithmic loss is finite, including at distributions with zero coordinates.

Defines the binary conditional margin risk eta(x)Phi(-u) + (1-eta(x))Phi(u), a supplied measurable extended-real conditional minimizer, surrogate risk, conditional-minimum risk, and R01(h) = P(Yh(X) ≤ 0).

For a measurable pair (U,V) of simplex-valued forecasts and a continuous jointly convex real function psi on the product simplex, the coordinatewise mean pair lies in that product and psi(EU,EV) ≤ E[psi(U,V)].

Assume AC. For every measurable feature T of a finite-label supervised prediction problem, there is a measurable conditional class-probability function eta_T such that eta_T(T(X)) is fully reliable, including identity and constant features.

seams_checked.note: Checked supervised-problem, population-risk and risk-measurability interfaces against their uses here. Finite full-power-set labels, measurable predictors and nonnegative extended losses preserve the supplier hypotheses; empirical risk is not invoked with an empty sample.

The group-risk-score definition accurately relates binary full reliability to calibration at distinct score values and explicitly distinguishes aggregate score calibration from per-bin calibration when scores repeat.

The top-label definition reproduces the supplier's top-confidence identity and smallest-index tie convention. Temperature scaling and binned ECE cite log/Brier propriety faithfully and explicitly avoid inferring a future-data calibration guarantee from it.

The finite-action Gibbs proof identifies KL with excess logarithmic score for K ≥ 2, using finite truthful loss and full support of the comparison forecast. Its singleton-label case is proved separately before invoking the supplier.
